title: Returned Payments and Certified-Funds-Only Status on the Home-Site Lease
content:
**Accounting conventions for a payment the bank returns on a Home-Site Lease**

- **Charge-back.** A returned payment is charged back to the rent ledger for exactly the amount of the payment returned, referenced to that payment. A payment is charged back only once; whether it already has been is read from the rent ledger.
- **Returned-payment fee.** The lot class's returned-payment fee is charged when the return reason is insufficient funds, account closed, stop payment or invalid account, and never when it is a bank processing error.
- **Certified-funds-only status.** Returned payments are counted over the lot class's lookback window — the trailing calendar months ending on, and including, the entry date of the newest returned payment, counted month for month on the calendar — and only returns for insufficient funds, account closed, stop payment or invalid account count. When that count reaches the lot class's threshold, the lease is placed on certified-funds-only status through the day before the same calendar date the lot class's restriction length later, counted from the entry date of the return that reached the count. Autopay is cancelled at the same time, because ACH debits are no longer accepted.
- **End of the status.** The restriction lapses on its own after its last day and is released early only when it was imposed in error.
- **Autopay discount.** A returned autopay draft also withholds the autopay discount for the lot class's withholding length in billing periods, starting with the period of the returned draft.

**Return reasons at a glance**

| Return reason | Charge-back | Returned-payment fee | Counts toward certified-funds-only status |
|---|---|---|---|
| insufficient funds | yes | yes | yes |
| account closed | yes | yes | yes |
| stop payment | yes | yes | yes |
| invalid account | yes | yes | yes |
| bank processing error | yes | no | no |

**Worked dates (hypothetical; threshold of two returns, restriction of twelve months)** — a first return for insufficient funds is followed by a second, for a stop payment, received on 10 February 2026 within the lookback window. The second return reaches the count; the lease is certified-funds-only from that return through 9 February 2027, and autopay is cancelled the same day. Had the second return been a bank processing error, it would not have counted and no restriction would follow from it.
